app.name: Yangsanhai Unpacker
app.tagline: yshjy · engine {version} · protocol v1 · MIT licensed
about.intro:
Built for archives that come down from a cloud drive named .mp4 or .png and then refuse to open in anything.
It finds where the real archive is hiding and hands that to a mature decoder; it can also pack files back into a fake video.
about.limits.title: What it does NOT do (hard limits)
about.limits.body:
· No network access, uploads nothing
· No dictionary or brute-force attacks, no built-in password lists
· Passwords it picks up are tried, never stored
· Always warns you before an extracted file is executable
about.report.title: Something went wrong?
about.report.body:
Generate a diagnostic bundle below (paths are redacted) and send that one zip to the developer.
It contains: version, system, the parameters used, and what was detected; it does **not** contain your file contents or passwords.
about.stateDir: Open state directory (crash logs live here)
about.footer: Made with Flutter + Rust · the GUI talks to the engine over docs/PROTOCOL.md
err.NOT_ARCHIVE: No archive found in there — it may not be a disguised archive, or the file is damaged
err.MISSING_VOLUME: Missing part — one volume is not here; download the missing one and try again
err.DATA_LOST: The file is damaged — only part of it can be recovered
err.ENCRYPTED_UNBREAKABLE: This archive is encrypted and the password cannot be guessed
err.HEAD_ENCRYPTED: Even the file list is encrypted — a password is required to see what is inside
err.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Invalid option (the selection may not fit)
err.NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE: Not enough disk space — free some up and try again
err.PERMISSION_DENIED: No permission to read or write that location (try another folder)
err.PATH_TOO_LONG: Path too long — the name does not fit at that location
err.DEST_IS_FILE: The destination is a file, not a folder (pick another folder)
err.VIDEO_UNPLAYABLE: The cover video itself is broken (does not affect extraction)
err.IO: File read/write error (disk full or a faulty disk)
err.INTERNAL: Internal error — use “Generate diagnostic bundle” and send it to the developer
err.ENGINE_EXITED: The engine process exited (restart the app)
err.TIMEOUT: Waited too long with no answer from the engine
err.BAD_PARAM: The GUI sent a bad parameter (software bug — please report it)
err.UNKNOWN_COMMAND: The engine does not know this command (version mismatch)
err.unknown: That did not work — cause unknown; try “Generate diagnostic bundle”
diag.HIDDEN_AT_OFFSET: The archive is hidden inside the file; located at its real offset
diag.REBUILT_INDEX: The index was damaged; the file list was rebuilt from file headers
diag.LAYOUT_GUESSED: Layout was guessed — not fully certain
diag.VIDEO_UNPLAYABLE: The cover video itself is broken (does not affect extraction)
diag.RISKY_ENTRY: An executable was extracted — check where it came from before running it
diag.SLOW_PATH: Using the slow path (full-file scan) — please be patient
diag.PASSWORD_FROM_NOTES: The password was found in the notes file next to the archive
diag.PARTIAL_DATA: Data is incomplete — recover as much as possible
diag.MOVABLE_NOT_VERIFIED: Target is a USB drive: eject safely before unplugging, or some data may not be written yet
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Hit Save to apply — no restart needed
settings.language.help: Only 简体中文 and English work so far. 繁體中文 / 日本語 / 한국어 / Español / Русский are still being translated and will appear here when ready — they are hidden for now so you never pick a language and see nothing happen.
settings.output.dir: Default output folder (empty = next to the archive)
settings.onDone.hint: “Move to trash” only puts it in the system trash (recoverable); this tool never permanently deletes files.
settings.notify.hint: One system notification when extraction/packing finishes or fails (needs notify-send on your system)
settings.openAfter: Open the output folder when done
settings.openAfter.hint: Off by default. Leave it off when unpacking a batch (one window per archive); turn it on when you unpack a single file and want to see the result, or just use the “Open output folder” button on the result page.
settings.flush: For USB drives, wait until the data is really written before reporting success
settings.flush.hint:
Off by default. When on and the target is a USB drive/flash card, extraction gets an extra “verifying writes” step and only finishes once the data is actually on the device — the window shows “do not unplug”. Internal disks are unaffected and never wait.
Note: on a slow USB stick this can take minutes (≈5 min for 300 MB on such a drive).
settings.autoNotes: Look for the password in a nearby “说明.txt”
settings.autoNotes.hint: Off by default. When on, the tool may read a notes file next to the archive to find a ready-made password (text only, never online). Keep it off if you do not want the tool reading text files next to your archives.
settings.autoBook: Try the passwords in your password book
settings.autoBook.hint: Off by default. When on, the tool tries the common passwords you wrote in the password book. It only tries what you recorded and what the notes file states — no dictionaries, no brute force.
settings.flush.note: Even when off, you still get the “eject safely before unplugging” reminder — it costs no time and can save your data.
settings.closeAction.hintWindows: Default is “Quit”. If you pick “Minimize to tray”, closing while busy hides the window and keeps working; get back from the tray icon anytime.
settings.closeAction.hintDefault: Default is “Minimize to tray”. Closing while busy hides the window and keeps working — get back from the tray menu anytime; when idle it quits as usual.
settings.saved: Saved — applies from the next job (no restart needed)
settings.section.caps: Per-format capabilities (asked from the engine, not hardcoded)
settings.caps.error: Could not read the capability table: {reason}
settings.caps.tooOld: This engine is too old (no formats in hello); upgrade the engine to see this
settings.misc.jobsValue: jobs = 1 (1 is best on a spinning disk)

pack.err.needCover: Disguise mode needs a cover file first (pick one under “Cover file” below)
pack.err.badVolume: That volume size is not valid — fix it before starting
pack.done.hint: Check the output folder, or open the History page
pack.mode.zip.desc: Compress folders/files into one .zip that any archive tool can open
pack.mode.disguise.desc: Pick a real file as the cover and hide the archive behind it — the output looks exactly like that file
pack.mode.zip.title: Plain compression (.zip)
pack.mode.disguise.title: Disguised as a file
pack.mode.sfx.title: Self-extracting package (double-click to unpack)
pack.mode.sfx.desc: The recipient needs no software; supports passwords, not split volumes
pack.empty: Add a folder or a few files first
pack.cover.hint:
This file is placed first, byte for byte, and the compressed data is appended after it. Videos, images, PDFs, music, exe, installers — anything works.
With an exe/installer, double-clicking runs that program itself, so pick a real file whose size and content make sense; a tiny cover looks unnatural.
pack.password: Password (optional — leave empty for no encryption)
pack.level.hint: Smaller is faster, larger saves space (default: Standard)
pack.layout.append: Don't touch the cover, append at the end (safer)
pack.layout.append.short: Don't touch the cover (disguise mode only)
pack.layout.append.desc: Data goes after the cover; the cover file is not modified at all
pack.layout.free: Default: store data inside the cover's video structure so the video still plays (pick this in most cases)
pack.layout.none: Plain compression / self-extracting has no cover, so layout doesn't apply
pack.scan.desc: Sprinkle 4 blocks of junk so scanners treat it as an ordinary video (about +64 KB)
pack.fingerprint.desc: Each block carries a fake signature to fool scanners that identify files by header
pack.volumes: Split into volumes (not supported for self-extracting)
pack.sha.desc: The recipient can run sha256sum -c to verify the download
pack.notes.desc: Tells the recipient it isn't really a video and how to open it (the password goes in too)
pack.flush.progress: Flushing to disk: about {size} left · waited {secs}s · ⚠️ do not unplug the device
pack.result.sfx:
✅ Self-extracting package done: {size}, {entries} entries
Send this exe to someone (Windows): double-clicking extracts it into a new folder next to it, no software needed.
pack.result.zip:
✅ Compressed: {size}, {entries} entries
This is a standard ZIP — any archive tool opens it directly.
pack.result.disguise:
✅ Packed: {size}, {entries} entries, {layout}
{cover}The cover file is kept as-is — double-clicking still opens it; the compressed data hides at the tail. Drag it into 杨三海解压 to recover.
pack.layout.free.name: free atomic layout (recommended)
pack.layout.append.name: tail-append layout
